english.title: Fail to give Office of Fair Trading / section 36 licensee notice within prescribed time limits
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who was required under section 36 of the Consumer Credit Act 1974 to give notice to

(A)_[the Office of Fair Trading]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), a licensee under that Act]_

failed to give such notice within the period prescribed in the said section
english.legislation: Contrary to section 39(3) of, and Schedule 1 to, the Consumer Credit Act 1974.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment a fine or both

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
